title: SQL & Relational Databases
intro: SQL database interviews test whether you can reason about query plans and transaction semantics, not just write SELECTs. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with SQL fundamentals (the relational model, the clauses), then joins and subqueries, then transactions and ACID (the most-asked topic — isolation levels, anomalies). Connection pooling, indexes, and query optimization are the performance tier — where senior interviewers probe. The advanced tier covers migrations, window functions, partitioning/sharding, replication, and backup/recovery. It closes with comparisons and scenario-based questions.
